in_marathi.name: Shaambhavika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambhavika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu, the god of the universe and the god of love. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shambhu' and 'Ika'. Shambhu means 'the god' and 'Ika' means 'one'. So, Shaambhavika means 'She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu'.

in_bengali.name: Shaambhavika

in_bengali.long_meaning: Shaambhavika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu, the god of the universe and the god of love. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shambhu' and 'Ika'. Shambhu means 'the god' and 'Ika' means 'one'. So, Shaambhavika means 'She who is the embodiment of Lord Shambhu'.
